conviction_note: One dated, document-backed mechanism: the 8-K's three-day VWAP pricing window for the $15.0m 2027-note exchange is Sep 23-25 and ends at today's close, so the counterparties' price-locking sales stop there (+1.5). I cut that to +0.5 because this name's own comparable falls rise only 34% of the time (median -1.97%), its 14-day ATR of 10.4% is the kind the base rate says keeps falling, the skew pays for downside, and Monday's true-up delivery could still be sold if a holder did not pre-hedge.

findings.finding: The exchange's three-day VWAP averaging window (Sep 23, 24, 25) ends at today's close. The sellers who were fixing the share count, and who drove three straight falls of -12.86%, -8.37% and -8.32% on 1-2x volume, stop selling before the next session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The seller that set the price is finished and dated. Per the 8-K, the VWAP that fixes the exchange share count is computed 'over the three trading days starting September 23, 2026', which is Sep 23-25. Averaging ends at the 2026-09-25 close and settles on or about 2026-09-28, so the holders have no pricing reason to keep selling after today.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's own comparable falls include the two earlier sessions of this window: 2026-09-23 (-12.86%) was followed by -8.37%, and 2026-09-24 (-8.37%) by -8.32%. That fits continuous pressure inside the averaging period. The baseline has no comparable post-window observation for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The intraday tape on the last averaging day still carries the price-locking sales. If the market fully expected them to stop, today's session would show a fade in selling into the close rather than a new 52-week low (pos_52w 0.0). The risk working against this: 848,265 true-up shares at most (about 0.4m at a VWAP near $9.4, estimated from the baseline's daily returns) are delivered 2026-09-28, and a holder who did not pre-hedge could sell them that day. That is why the size is 1.5 and not more.

baseline_tension: The finding cuts against this name's own reaction function (34% up-rate, median -1.97%), its high ATR and the positive put skew. It agrees with the under-2x volume and with the -10..-7.5 drop band, both mildly positive. So expected_move is +0.5, one point below the +1.5 finding.
